---
title: Native mode with number-lines and startFrom
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
    syntax-highlighting: idiomatic
    code-annotations: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: default
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - '#quarto-code-annotation\(\("1": 1, "2": 2\), cell-id: "lst-n"\)'
        -
          - 'quarto-code-annotations:'
          - '# <'
---

y = 2  # <2>

1. First.
2. Second.
